scope.label: Scope note.
scope.body: Everyone on this marketplace is a non-medical wellbeing professional. They do not diagnose, prescribe or replace clinical care. Where a need is clinical, the platform routes it back to your BridgeCare care team rather than to a listing.
scope.short: This professional is non-medical. They do not diagnose, prescribe or replace clinical care.

discover.title: Find the person who actually helps, not the first one who answers.
discover.lede: Verified non-medical health professionals — coaches, therapists, trainers and carers — brokered, background-checked and booked in one place.

categories.lede: Four families of care. Everyone listed is non-medical — we broker alongside your clinician, never instead of one.

how.title: How the brokerage works
how.lede: Four steps, and money only moves after the session happens.

search.title: 1 · Search
search.body: Filter by need, format, city, price and rating. Every profile shows credentials and real reviews.

request.title: 2 · Request
request.body: Send a request for a specific slot. The professional accepts or proposes another time.

meet.title: 3 · Meet
meet.body: Online, at their studio, or at your home. Carers and home visitors are all background-checked.

settle.title: 4 · Settle
settle.body: The fee is held and released after the session, with the brokerage fee already included in the price you see. The free cancellation window is shown before you confirm.

filters.priceNote: The cheapest service you can actually buy. A listing that publishes only free services is not priced and does not appear in a budget.
filters.ratingNote: A professional with no reviews yet is not rated, so a rating filter does not include them.
filters.verifiedNote: Verification covers identity, stated credentials and — for home visitors — a police clearance.
